meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在查找代码、改 1-2 个文件、审查 diff 这类活儿上会交给 cavecrew 子代理去做。子代理返回的工具结果是压缩过的,主上下文占用更小,一次会话里能多用几轮。
howto.when: 当你要定位代码、做范围明确的小改动(≤2 个文件)、或审查 diff 时,会委派给对应的 cavecrew 子代理;想要架构建议、大范围重构或深度评审则不用它。

say.text: 用 cavecrew-investigator 找一下 X 在哪定义、谁调用了它
say.note: 返回路径加行号的清单

say.text: 让 cavecrew-builder 把这两个文件里的 Y 改掉
say.note: 只做 2 个文件以内的手术式编辑

say.text: 用 cavecrew-reviewer 审一下这次的 diff
say.note: 只报问题,不给架构意见

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude delegates code lookup, small edits, and diff review to cavecrew subagents. Their tool results return compressed, so the main context shrinks per delegation and lasts longer across a session.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude needs to locate code, make a surgical edit in 1-2 files, or review a diff. For architecture suggestions, deep review, or 3+ file refactors it stays on the main thread.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-investigator to find where X is defined and what calls it
say_en.note: Returns a path:line list of sites

say_en.text: Have cavecrew-builder change Y in these two files
